message: 狩りだハロウィンだ！

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today is Meat or Chicken, isn't it!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huuh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Pumpkin Princess of the Salad Kingdom comes down to the Human World and gives presents to good boys and girls, you know.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sounds like someone rolling in dough! Think she'll give us something tasty?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh right, it's Halloween.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it that time of year already.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ryuusei Town really goes all out for Halloween, doesn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's quite fashionable, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's been a trade port for ages, too. Folks were making a fuss over it since I was a little kid.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. Since the era when you all wore topknots, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Girls don't wear topknots, you know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even guys didn't wear 'em back then.」

name: Misa
message: 「I make pumpkin sweets every year.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa, have you ever gone trick-or-treating?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You won't get any sweets unless you properly call it Meat or Chicken, you know.」

name: Sally
message: 「What?! You can get sweets?! The Pumpkin Princess is awesome!」

name: Ria
message: 「I haven't, no, it just feels... kind of embarrassing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Barging into other people's homes is a bit much.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's this? That ain't like you, Hisa. I figured you'd cross your arms, look down your nose at folks, and make the rounds saying, 'Hand over the sweets!'」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy, that is a complete misunderstanding!」

name: Synn
message: 「Halloween... it used to be an all-you-can-eat sweets day...」

name: Ria
message: 「All-you-can-eat? Oh, right, because it's Halloween.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn and I used to make the rounds through the Ryuusei Shopping District together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, here comes a classic childhood friend memory!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A sweet memory just between the two of us!」

name: Synn
message: 「Countless memories flashing back like my life before my eyes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, 'flashing before your eyes' sounds pretty bad.」

name: Synn
message: 「Making Jack-o'-lanterns was fun.」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jack-o'-lanterns!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka is actually really good at making them.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, yeah, we made them every year so I just got the hang of it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that right...」

name: Synn
message: 「It was tough because if we didn't scoop out the insides cleanly, it'd get in our hair.」

name: Ria
message: 「Get in your hair?」

name: Sally
message: 「Throwing away the insides is such a waaaste!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine. Synn's mom turned it into a pumpkin cheesecake for us. That was so good.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eaaat it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Once we filled up on cake and night fell, it was time for the hunt to begin!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hunt?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking of hunting, it's time for rice porridge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Put on the Jack-o'-lantern, grab a flashlight, and we're all set for candy hunting!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So it's a hunt, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「We went all around the shopping district and got candy, didn't we.」

name: Ria
message: 「D-Don't tell me... wearing the Jack-o'-lanterns?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep. We thought that was just how you're supposed to do it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It says right here that wearing a pumpkin on your head is the traditional formal attire for Halloween.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... Jack-o'-lanterns...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Ria-senpai, you look a little pale?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's probably just the fluorescent lights.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you even use a flashlight for?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Holding it in your hand to shine up at your face from below, obviously.」

name: Misa
message: 「What bad taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「For some reason, we just thought that's how it was done.」
Back then, we were always together.

name: Ria
message: 「...Shiver, tremble.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoever lost at rock-paper-scissors had to ding-dong ditch. Then when the person inside came out, we'd pop out from the dark.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Going, 'Hand over the candy if you value your life!'」

name: Ria
message: 「E-Eek!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's nothing. Ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When we were on the case, not a single house refused to hand over candy. Ahahahaha!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. I shall put on a jack-o'-lantern and parade through town at once.」

name: Sally
message: 「I want the insides!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got so much of that wrong.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, what can you do? We were just kids.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So anything is forgiven if you are a child. In that case, starting today, I am a child.」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmph. I'm a super charismastic adult, so no luck for me! What a shame!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, you're the biggest kid here.」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?!」
